     2→package com.jonnyzzz.mcpSteroid.mcp
     3→
     4→import com.intellij.openapi.diagnostic.Logger
     5→import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
     6→import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject
     7→import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
     8→import kotlin.time.Duration.Companion.seconds
     9→
    10→private val log = Logger.getInstance("com.jonnyzzz.mcpSteroid.mcp.McpRootsService")
    11→
    12→/**
    13→ * Service for managing MCP Roots per session.
    14→ *
    15→ * Roots define filesystem boundaries that clients expose to servers.
    16→ * Per MCP 2025-11-25 specification: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/client/roots
    17→ *
    18→ * This service:
    19→ * - Requests roots from clients via roots/list
    20→ * - Caches roots per session
    21→ * - Handles roots/list_changed notifications
    22→ * - Refreshes cached roots when notified of changes
    23→ */
    24→class McpRootsService {
    25→    private val rootsCache = ConcurrentHashMap<String, List<Root>>()
    26→
    27→    /**
    28→     * Get roots for a session, requesting from client if not cached.
    29→     * Returns null if client doesn't support roots or request fails.
    30→     */
    31→    suspend fun getRoots(session: McpSession, forceRefresh: Boolean = false): List<Root>? {
    32→        if (!session.supportsRoots()) {
    33→            log.debug("[Roots] Session ${session.id} does not support roots capability")
    34→            return null
    35→        }
    36→
    37→        // Return cached if available and not forcing refresh
    38→        if (!forceRefresh) {
    39→            rootsCache[session.id]?.let { cached ->
    40→                log.debug("[Roots] Returning ${cached.size} cached roots for session ${session.id}")
    41→                return cached
    42→            }
    43→        }
    44→
    45→        // Request roots from client
    46→        log.info("[Roots] Requesting roots from client for session ${session.id}")
    47→
    48→        val result = try {
    49→            session.sendRequest(
    50→                method = McpMethods.ROOTS_LIST,
    51→                params = buildJsonObject { }, // roots/list takes no params
    52→                timeout = 30.seconds
    53→            )
    54→        } catch (e: Exception) {
    55→            log.warn("[Roots] Failed to request roots for session ${session.id}", e)
    56→            return null
    57→        }
    58→
    59→        if (result == null) {
    60→            log.warn("[Roots] Client did not respond to roots/list for session ${session.id}")
    61→            return null
    62→        }
    63→
    64→        // Parse response
    65→        val rootsResult = try {
    66→            McpJson.decodeFromJsonElement(RootsListResult.serializer(), result)
    67→        } catch (e: Exception) {
    68→            log.error("[Roots] Failed to parse roots/list response for session ${session.id}", e)
    69→            return null
    70→        }
    71→
    72→        log.info("[Roots] Received ${rootsResult.roots.size} roots for session ${session.id}")
    73→        rootsResult.roots.forEachIndexed { i, root ->
    74→            log.debug("[Roots]   [$i] ${root.name ?: "Unnamed"}: ${root.uri}")
    75→        }
    76→
    77→        // Cache the result
    78→        rootsCache[session.id] = rootsResult.roots
    79→        return rootsResult.roots
    80→    }
    81→
    82→    /**
    83→     * Handle roots/list_changed notification from client.
    84→     * Clears cached roots for the session to force refresh on next getRoots().
    85→     */
    86→    fun handleRootsListChanged(session: McpSession) {
    87→        if (!session.supportsRootsListChanged()) {
    88→            log.warn("[Roots] Session ${session.id} sent roots/list_changed but didn't declare listChanged capability")
    89→        }
    90→
    91→        log.info("[Roots] Roots list changed for session ${session.id}, clearing cache")
    92→        rootsCache.remove(session.id)
    93→    }
    94→
    95→    /**
    96→     * Clear cached roots for a session (e.g., when session closes).
    97→     */
    98→    fun clearCache(sessionId: String) {
    99→        rootsCache.remove(sessionId)
   100→        log.debug("[Roots] Cleared roots cache for session $sessionId")
   101→    }
   102→
   103→    /**
   104→     * Clear all cached roots.
   105→     */
   106→    fun clearAllCaches() {
   107→        val count = rootsCache.size
   108→        rootsCache.clear()
   109→        log.info("[Roots] Cleared all roots caches ($count sessions)")
   110→    }
   111→
   112→    /**
   113→     * Get cached roots without requesting from client.
   114→     * Returns null if not cached.
   115→     */
   116→    fun getCachedRoots(sessionId: String): List<Root>? {
   117→        return rootsCache[sessionId]
   118→    }
   119→
   120→    /**
   121→     * Check if roots are cached for a session.
   122→     */
   123→    fun hasCachedRoots(sessionId: String): Boolean {
   124→        return rootsCache.containsKey(sessionId)
   125→    }
   126→
   127→    /**
   128→     * Get number of sessions with cached roots.
   129→     */
   130→    fun getCacheSize(): Int {
   131→        return rootsCache.size
   132→    }
   133→}
   134→

    29→/**
    30→ * Handler for the steroid_open_project MCP tool.
    31→ *
    32→ * This tool initiates opening a project in IntelliJ. It does NOT wait for the project
    33→ * to fully open - instead it returns quickly so the client can interact with any dialogs
    34→ * that may appear (such as the trust project dialog) using screenshot/input tools.
    35→ *
    36→ * The tool can optionally trust the project path before opening, which allows skipping
    37→ * the trust dialog.
    38→ */
    39→class OpenProjectToolHandler : McpRegistrar {
    40→    private val log = thisLogger()
    41→    private val toolDescription = """
    42→        Open a project in the IDE. This tool initiates the project opening process and returns quickly.
    43→
    44→        IMPORTANT: Project opening is ASYNCHRONOUS. This tool returns immediately; you MUST poll to verify the project is fully ready before using it.
    45→
    46→        Verification Workflow:
    47→        1. Call steroid_open_project with the project path
    48→        2. Poll steroid_list_windows repeatedly (every 2-3 seconds) until:
    49→           - The project appears in the windows list
    50→           - modalDialogShowing is false (no dialogs blocking)
    51→           - indexingInProgress is false (indexing complete)
    52→           - projectInitialized is true
    53→        3. If modalDialogShowing is true, use steroid_take_screenshot + steroid_input to handle dialogs
    54→        4. Use steroid_take_screenshot to visually confirm the project is fully loaded
    55→        5. Verify with steroid_list_projects that the project appears
    56→
    57→        Dialog Handling:
    58→        - If trust_project=true (default), the trust dialog is skipped automatically
    59→        - Other dialogs (project type, SDK selection, etc.) may still appear
    60→        - Always check modalDialogShowing in steroid_list_windows response
    61→    """.trimIndent()
    62→
    63→    override fun register(server: McpServerCore) {
    64→        server.toolRegistry.registerTool(
    65→            name = "steroid_open_project",
    66→            description = toolDescription,
    67→            inputSchema = buildJsonObject {
    68→                put("type", "object")
    69→                putJsonObject("properties") {
    70→                    putJsonObject("project_path") {
    71→                        put("type", "string")
    72→                        put("description", "Absolute path to the project directory to open.")
    73→                    }
    74→                    putJsonObject("task_id") {
    75→                        put("type", "string")
    76→                        put("description", "Your task identifier to group related executions.")
    77→                    }
    78→                    putJsonObject("reason") {
    79→                        put("type", "string")
    80→                        put("description", "Reason for opening the project. Required for audit logs.")
    81→                    }
    82→                    putJsonObject("trust_project") {
    83→                        put("type", "boolean")
    84→                        put("description", "If true, trust the project path before opening (skips trust dialog). Default: true")
    85→                    }
    86→                }
    87→                putJsonArray("required") {
    88→                    add("project_path")
    89→                    add("task_id")
    90→                    add("reason")
    91→                }
    92→            },
    93→            ::handle
    94→        )
    95→    }

    98→        val args = context.params.arguments ?: return errorResult("Missing arguments")
    99→        val projectPathStr = args["project_path"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   100→            ?: return errorResult("Missing required parameter: project_path")
   101→        args["task_id"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   102→            ?: return errorResult("Missing required parameter: task_id")
   103→        args["reason"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   104→            ?: return errorResult("Missing required parameter: reason")
   105→        val trustProject = args["trust_project"]?.jsonPrimitive?.boolean ?: true
   106→
   107→        val projectPath = try {
   108→            Path.of(projectPathStr)
   109→        } catch (e: Exception) {
   110→            return errorResult("Invalid project path: $projectPathStr - ${e.message}")
   111→        }
   112→
   113→        // Validate that the path exists
   114→        if (!Files.exists(projectPath)) {
   115→            return errorResult("Project path does not exist: $projectPath")
   116→        }
   117→
   118→        // Check if project is already open
   119→        val existingProject = readAction {
   120→            ProjectManager.getInstance().openProjects.find { project ->
   121→                project.basePath?.let { Path.of(it) == projectPath.toAbsolutePath() } == true
   122→            }
   123→        }
   124→
   125→        if (existingProject != null) {
   126→            return ToolCallResult.builder()
   127→                .addTextContent("Project is already open: ${existingProject.name}")
   128→                .addTextContent("Project path: ${existingProject.basePath}")
   129→                .addTextContent("Use steroid_list_projects to see all open projects.")
   130→                .build()
   131→        }
   132→
   133→        val builder = ToolCallResult.builder()
   134→        fun log(message: String) {
   135→            builder.addTextContent(message)
   136→            context.mcpProgressReporter.report(message)
   137→        }
   138→
   139→        try {

   141→            if (trustProject) {

   144→                log("Project path trusted successfully")

   147→            log("Initiating project open: $projectPath")

    16→/**
    17→ * Handler for the steroid_execute_feedback MCP tool.
    18→ *
    19→ * Allows agents to provide feedback on execution results, including:
    20→ * - Success rating (0.00 to 1.00)
    21→ * - Explanation of the rating
    22→ * - Association with a task_id
    23→ */
    24→class ExecuteFeedbackToolHandler : McpRegistrar {
    25→    private val log = thisLogger()
    26→    private val json = Json {
    27→        prettyPrint = true
    28→    }
    29→
    30→    private val toolDescription get() = """
    31→            Provide feedback on the result of a steroid_execute_code call.
    32→            
    33→            Use this tool to rate execution results and track what worked or didn't work.
    34→            
    35→            PARAMETERS:
    36→            - project_name: The project where execution occurred
    37→            - task_id: The same task_id you used in steroid_execute_code
    38→            - execution_id: The execution_id returned in the steroid_execute_code result
    39→            - success_rating: Rate from 0.00 (complete failure) to 1.00 (complete success)
    40→              - 0.00-0.25: Complete failure, nothing worked
    41→              - 0.25-0.50: Partial failure, some errors occurred
    42→              - 0.50-0.75: Partial success, achieved some goals
    43→              - 0.75-1.00: Success, achieved the intended goal
    44→            - explanation: Describe what worked, what didn't, and what you'll try next
    45→            - code (optional): The code snippet that was executed
    46→            
    47→            Feedback helps track execution history and identify patterns for improvement.
    48→        """.trimIndent()
    49→
    50→    override fun register(server: McpServerCore) {
    51→        server.toolRegistry.registerTool(
    52→            name = "steroid_execute_feedback",
    53→            description = toolDescription,
    54→            inputSchema = buildJsonObject {
    55→                put("type", "object")
    56→                putJsonObject("properties") {
    57→                    putJsonObject("project_name") {
    58→                        put("type", "string")
    59→                        put("description", "Project name (from steroid_list_projects)")
    60→                    }
    61→                    putJsonObject("task_id") {
    62→                        put("type", "string")
    63→                        put("description", "The task_id you used when calling steroid_execute_code")
    64→                    }
    65→                    putJsonObject("execution_id") {
    66→                        put("type", "string")
    67→                        put("description", "The execution_id returned from the most recent steroid_execute_code call for this task")
    68→                    }
    69→                    putJsonObject("success_rating") {
    70→                        put("type", "number")
    71→                        put("minimum", 0.0)
    72→                        put("maximum", 1.0)
    73→                        put("description", "Rate the success of the execution from 0.00 (complete failure) to 1.00 (complete success)")
    74→                    }
    75→                    putJsonObject("explanation") {
    76→                        put("type", "string")
    77→                        put("description", "Explain why you gave this rating. What worked? What didn't? What will you try next?")
    78→                    }
    79→                    putJsonObject("code") {
    80→                        put("type", "string")
    81→                        put("description", "Optional: The code snippet that was executed. Useful for tracking what code produced which results.")
    82→                    }
    83→                }
    84→                putJsonArray("required") {
    85→                    add("project_name")
    86→                    add("task_id")
    87→                    add("success_rating")
    88→                    add("explanation")
    89→                }

    93→        }
    94→    }

    96→    private suspend fun handle(params: ToolCallParams): ToolCallResult {
    97→        val args = params.arguments ?: return errorResult("Missing arguments")
    98→
    99→        val projectName = args["project_name"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   100→            ?: return errorResult("Missing required parameter: project_name")
   101→        val taskId = args["task_id"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   102→            ?: return errorResult("Missing required parameter: task_id")
   103→        // execution_id is optional — noted for context but value is not currently used
   104→        val successRating = args["success_rating"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull
   105→            ?: return errorResult("Missing required parameter: success_rating")
   106→        val explanation = args["explanation"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   107→        val code = args["code"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   108→
   109→        // Validate success_rating
   110→        if (successRating !in 0.0..1.0) {
   111→            return errorResult("success_rating must be between 0.00 and 1.00")
   112→        }
   113→
   114→        log.info("Feedback is submitted: " + json.encodeToString(params.rawArguments))
   115→
   116→        val project = readAction {
   117→            getInstance().openProjects.find { it.name == projectName }
   118→        } ?: return errorResult("Project not found: $projectName")
   119→
   120→        runCatching {
   121→            val executionStorage = project.service<ExecutionStorage>()
   122→            val executionId = executionStorage.writeExecutionFeedback(taskId = taskId, params)
   123→            if (code != null) {
   124→                executionStorage.writeCodeExecutionData(executionId, "script.kts", code)
   125→            }
   126→
   127→            if (explanation != null) {
   128→                executionStorage.writeCodeExecutionData(executionId, "explanation.txt", explanation)
   129→            }
   130→        }
   131→
   132→        // Capture feedback event
   133→        analyticsBeacon.capture(

   135→            project = project,
   136→            properties = mapOf(
   137→                "success_rating" to successRating,
   138→                "has_explanation" to (explanation != null),
   139→                "has_code" to (code != null)
   140→            )
   141→        )
   142→

   144→        val score = (successRating * 100).toInt()

   146→            score = score,
   147→            context = "feedback",
   148→            project = project,
   149→            properties = mapOf(
   150→                "task_id" to taskId
   151→            )
   152→        )
   153→
   154→        return ToolCallResult(
   155→            content = listOf(ContentItem.Text(text = "ACK!"))
   156→        )
   157→    }

    48→
    49→suspend fun collectListWindowsResponse(): ListWindowsResponse {
    50→    // Use DialogWindowsLookup for reliable modal detection:
    51→    // fast negative path (canPumpEdtNonModal), then EDT check if needed.
    52→    val lookup = dialogWindowsLookup()
    53→    val (windowInfos, progressTasks) = lookup.withModalityCheck { isModalShowing ->
    54→        // Window enumeration runs on EDT with ModalityState.any() so it works
    55→        // even when a modal dialog is blocking the normal EDT dispatcher.
    56→        withContext(Dispatchers.EDT + ModalityState.any().asContextElement()) {
    57→            val frames = WindowManager.getInstance().allProjectFrames.toList()
    58→
    59→            // Collect progress indicators from all frames
    60→            val allProgressTasks = mutableListOf<ProgressTaskInfo>()
    61→
    62→            val frameInfos = frames.map { frame ->
    63→                val project = frame.project
    64→                val component = frame.component
    65→                val window = SwingUtilities.getWindowAncestor(component)
    66→                val bounds = window?.bounds
    67→
    68→                // Collect progress tasks from the status bar using new ProgressModel API
    69→                val statusBar = frame.statusBar as? StatusBarEx
    70→                statusBar?.let { bar ->
    71→                    val tasks = bar.backgroundProcessModels
    72→                    tasks.forEach { pair ->
    73→val taskInfo = pair.first
    74→                        val progressModel = pair.second
    75→                        allProgressTasks.add(
    76→                            ProgressTaskInfo(
    77→                                title = taskInfo.title,
    78→                                text = progressModel.getText() ?: "",
    79→                                text2 = progressModel.getDetails() ?: "",
    80→                                fraction = if (progressModel.isIndeterminate()) null else progressModel.getFraction(),
    81→                                isIndeterminate = progressModel.isIndeterminate(),
    82→                                isCancellable = progressModel.isCancellable(),
    83→                                projectName = project?.name
    84→                            )
    85→                        )
    86→                    }
    87→                }
    88→
    89→                WindowInfo(
    90→                    projectName = project?.name,
    91→                    projectPath = project?.basePath,
    92→                    title = (window as? java.awt.Frame)?.title,
    93→                    isActive = window?.isActive ?: false,
    94→                    isVisible = window?.isVisible ?: false,
    95→                    bounds = bounds?.let { WindowBounds(it.x, it.y, it.width, it.height) },
    96→                    windowId = WindowIdUtil.compute(window, component),
    97→                    modalDialogShowing = isModalShowing,
    98→                    indexingInProgress = project?.let { DumbService.isDumb(it) },
    99→                    projectInitialized = project?.isInitialized,
   100→                )
   101→            }
   102→
   103→            val knownWindowIds = frameInfos.map { it.windowId }.toMutableSet()
   104→            val extraInfos = java.awt.Window.getWindows()
   105→                .filter { it.isDisplayable }
   106→                .mapNotNull { window ->
   107→                    val windowId = WindowIdUtil.compute(window, window)
   108→                    if (!knownWindowIds.add(windowId)) return@mapNotNull null
   109→                    val bounds = window.bounds
   110→                    WindowInfo(
   111→                        projectName = null,
   112→                        projectPath = null,
   113→                        title = (window as? java.awt.Frame)?.title,
   114→                        isActive = window.isActive,
   115→                        isVisible = window.isVisible,
   116→                        bounds = WindowBounds(bounds.x, bounds.y, bounds.width, bounds.height),
   117→                        windowId = windowId,
   118→                        modalDialogShowing = isModalShowing,
   119→                    )
   120→                }
   121→
   122→            (frameInfos + extraInfos) to allProgressTasks.toList()
   123→        }
   124→    }
   125→
   126→    return ListWindowsResponse(
   127→        windows = windowInfos,
   128→        backgroundTasks = progressTasks,
   129→    )
   130→}

    39→class ExecuteCodeToolHandler : McpRegistrar {
    40→    private val toolDescription get() = ExecuteCodeToolDescriptionPromptArticle().readPayload(ResourceRegistrar.buildPromptsContext())
    41→
    42→    override fun register(server: McpServerCore) {
    43→        server.toolRegistry.registerTool(
    44→            name = "steroid_execute_code",
    45→            description = toolDescription,
    46→            inputSchema = buildJsonObject {
    47→                put("type", "object")
    48→                putJsonObject("properties") {
    49→                    putJsonObject("project_name") {
    50→                        put("type", "string")
    51→                        put("description", "Project name (from steroid_list_projects)")
    52→                    }
    53→                    putJsonObject("code") {
    54→                        put("type", "string")
    55→                        put("description", "Kotlin suspend method body")
    56→                    }
    57→                    putJsonObject("task_id") {

    59→                        put("description", "Your task identifier to group related executions. Use the same task_id for all execute_code calls that are part of the same task, and when providing feedback via steroid_execute_feedback.")
    60→                    }
    61→                    putJsonObject("reason") {
    62→                        put("type", "string")
    63→                        put("description", "IMPORTANT: On your FIRST call, provide the FULL TASK DESCRIPTION from the user - what they originally asked you to do. On subsequent calls, describe what this specific execution aims to achieve. This helps track progress and understand context.")
    64→                    }
    65→                    putJsonObject("timeout") {
    66→                        put("type", "integer")
    67→                        put("description", "Execution timeout in seconds (default: 600, configurable via mcp.steroid.execution.timeout registry key)")
    68→                    }
    69→                    putJsonObject("dialog_killer") {
    70→                        put("type", "boolean")
    71→                        put("description", "Override pre-execution dialog killer: true = force enable, false = force disable. Default: use registry setting (mcp.steroid.dialog.killer.enabled).")
    72→                    }
    73→                    putJsonObject("required_plugins") {
    74→                        put("type", "array")
    75→                        putJsonObject("items") {
    76→                            put("type", "string")
    77→                        }
    78→                        put(
    79→                            "description",
    80→                            "Optional list of required plugin IDs (example: com.intellij.database). " +
    81→                                "Use steroid_capabilities to list installed plugins."
    82→                        )
    83→                    }
    84→                }
    85→                putJsonArray("required") {
    86→                    add("project_name")
    87→                    add("code")
    88→                    add("reason")
    89→                    add("task_id")
    90→                }
    91→            },
    92→            ::handle
    93→        )
    94→    }
    95→
    96→    private suspend fun handle(context: ToolCallContext): ToolCallResult {
    97→        val params = context.params
    98→        val args = params.arguments ?: return errorResult("Missing arguments")
    99→
   100→        val projectName = args["project_name"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   101→            ?: return errorResult("Missing required parameter: project_name")
   102→        val code = args["code"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   103→            ?: return errorResult("Missing required parameter: code")
   104→        val taskId = args["task_id"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   105→            ?: return errorResult("Missing required parameter: task_id")
   106→        val reason = args["reason"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   107→        val timeout = args["timeout"]?.jsonPrimitive?.intOrNull ?: Registry.intValue("mcp.steroid.execution.timeout", 600)
   108→        val dialogKiller = args["dialog_killer"]?.jsonPrimitive?.booleanOrNull
   109→        val requiredPlugins = args["required_plugins"]
   110→            ?.jsonArray
   111→            ?.mapNotNull { it.jsonPrimitive.contentOrNull }
   112→            ?.filter { it.isNotBlank() }
   113→            ?: emptyList()
   114→
   115→        val missingPlugins = findMissingPlugins(requiredPlugins)
   116→        if (missingPlugins.isNotEmpty()) {
   117→            return errorResult(
   118→                "Missing required plugins: ${missingPlugins.joinToString(", ")}. " +
   119→                    "Use steroid_capabilities to list installed plugins."
   120→            )
   121→        }
   122→
   123→        val (project, availableNames) = readAction {
   124→            val openProjects = getInstance().openProjects
   125→            openProjects.find { it.name == projectName } to openProjects.map { it.name }
   126→        }
   127→        if (project == null) {
   128→            return errorResult("Project not found: \"$projectName\". Available projects: $availableNames")
   129→        }
   130→
   131→        val execCodeParams = ExecCodeParams(
   132→            taskId = taskId,
   133→            code = code,
   134→            reason = reason ?: "No reason provided",
   135→            timeout = timeout,
   136→            dialogKiller = dialogKiller,
   137→            rawParams = args
   138→        )
   139→
   140→        val result = project
   141→            .service<ExecutionManager>()
   142→            .executeWithProgress(execCodeParams, context.mcpProgressReporter)
   143→
   144→        runCatching {
   145→            analyticsBeacon.capture(
   146→                event = "exec_code",
   147→                project = project,
   148→                properties = mapOf(
   149→                    "result" to if (result.isError) "error" else "success"
   150→                )
   151→            )
   152→        }
   153→
   154→        return result
   155→    }
   156→
   157→    private fun errorResult(message: String) = ToolCallResult(
   158→        content = listOf(ContentItem.Text(text = "ERROR: $message")),
   159→        isError = true
   160→    )
   161→
   162→    private fun findMissingPlugins(requiredPlugins: List<String>): List<String> {
   163→        if (requiredPlugins.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
   164→        return requiredPlugins.filter { pluginId ->
   165→            val resolvedId = PluginId.getId(pluginId)
   166→            val resolved = PluginManagerCore.getPlugin(resolvedId)
   167→            resolved == null || !PluginManagerCore.isLoaded(resolvedId)
   168→        }
   169→    }
   170→
   171→}

   102→class ActionDiscoveryToolHandler : McpRegistrar {
   103→    override fun register(server: McpServerCore) {
   104→        server.toolRegistry.registerTool(
   105→            name = "steroid_action_discovery",
   106→            description = "Discover available editor actions, quick-fixes, and gutter actions for a file and caret offset.",
   107→            inputSchema = buildJsonObject {
   108→                put("type", "object")
   109→                putJsonObject("properties") {
   110→                    putJsonObject("project_name") {
   111→                        put("type", "string")
   112→                        put("description", "Name of the project containing the file (from steroid_list_projects).")
   113→                    }
   114→                    putJsonObject("file_path") {
   115→                        put("type", "string")
   116→                        put("description", "Absolute path or project-relative path to the file.")
   117→                    }
   118→                    putJsonObject("caret_offset") {
   119→                        put("type", "integer")
   120→                        put("description", "Caret offset within the file (default: 0).")
   121→                    }
   122→                    putJsonObject("action_groups") {
   123→                        put("type", "array")
   124→                        putJsonObject("items") { put("type", "string") }
   125→                        put("description", "Optional list of action group IDs to expand (default: editor popup + gutter).")
   126→                    }
   127→                    putJsonObject("max_actions_per_group") {
   128→                        put("type", "integer")
   129→                        put("description", "Limit the number of actions returned per action group (default: 200).")
   130→                    }
   131→                    putJsonObject("task_id") {
   132→                        put("type", "string")
   133→                        put("description", "Optional task ID for log grouping.")
   134→                    }
   135→                }
   136→                putJsonArray("required") {
   137→                    add(JsonPrimitive("project_name"))
   138→                    add(JsonPrimitive("file_path"))
   139→                }
   140→            },
   141→            ::handle
   142→        )
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    private suspend fun handle(context: ToolCallContext): ToolCallResult {
   146→        val args = context.params.arguments ?: return errorResult("Missing arguments")
   147→        val projectName = args["project_name"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   148→            ?: return errorResult("Missing required parameter: project_name")
   149→        val filePath = args["file_path"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   150→            ?: return errorResult("Missing required parameter: file_path")
   151→        val caretOffset = args["caret_offset"]?.jsonPrimitive?.intOrNull ?: 0
   152→        val actionGroups = parseActionGroups(args["action_groups"]?.jsonArray)
   153→        val maxActions = args["max_actions_per_group"]?.jsonPrimitive?.intOrNull?.coerceAtLeast(0) ?: 200
   154→        val taskId = args["task_id"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
   155→
   156→        val project = readAction {
   157→            ProjectManager.getInstance().openProjects.find { it.name == projectName }
   158→        } ?: return errorResult("Project not found: $projectName")
   159→
   160→project.executionStorage.writeToolCall(
   161→            toolName = "steroid_action_discovery",
   162→            arguments = context.params.arguments,
   163→            taskId = taskId
   164→        )
   165→
   166→        val virtualFile = resolveVirtualFile(project, filePath)
   167→            ?: return errorResult("File not found: $filePath")
   168→        val psiFile = readAction { PsiManager.getInstance(project).findFile(virtualFile) }
   169→            ?: return errorResult("PSI not available for: $filePath")
   170→        val document = readAction { PsiDocumentManager.getInstance(project).getDocument(psiFile) }
   171→            ?: return errorResult("No document for: $filePath")
   172→        val safeOffset = caretOffset.coerceIn(0, document.textLength)
   173→
   174→        val textEditor = openTextEditor(project, virtualFile, safeOffset)
   175→            ?: return errorResult("No text editor available for: $filePath")
   176→        val editor = textEditor.editor
   177→        if (editor.isDisposed) return errorResult("Editor disposed for: $filePath")
   178→
   179→        awaitSmartMode(project)
   180→        withContext(Dispatchers.EDT) { }
   181→        withContext(Dispatchers.EDT) {
   182→            if (!editor.isDisposed) {
   183→                editor.caretModel.moveToOffset(safeOffset)
   184→                editor.scrollingModel.scrollToCaret(ScrollType.CENTER)
   185→            }
   186→        }
   187→
   188→        DaemonCodeAnalyzer.getInstance(project).restart(psiFile, "steroid_action_discovery")
   189→        val highlightCompleted = awaitHighlighting(project, textEditor)
   190→
   191→        val intentionsInfo = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
   192→            readAction { ShowIntentionsPass.getActionsToShow(editor, psiFile) }
   193→        }
   194→
   195→        val dataContext = withContext(Dispatchers.EDT) {
   196→            DataManager.getInstance().getDataContext(editor.component)
   197→        }
   198→
   199→        val actionGroupInfo = actionGroups.map { groupId ->
   200→            val place = placeForGroup(groupId)
   201→            val action = ActionManager.getInstance().getAction(groupId)
   202→            if (action !is ActionGroup) {
   203→                ActionGroupInfo(
   204→                    groupId = groupId,
   205→                    place = place,
   206→                    actions = emptyList(),
   207→                    missing = true
   208→                )
   209→            } else {
   210→                val actions = expandActionGroup(action, dataContext, place, maxActions)
   211→                ActionGroupInfo(
   212→                    groupId = groupId,
   213→                    place = place,
   214→                    actions = actions
   215→                )
   216→            }
   217→        }
   218→
   219→        val gutterIcons = collectGutterIcons(project, document, dataContext, maxActions)
   220→
   221→        val notes = buildList<String> {
   222→            if (!highlightCompleted) {
   223→                add("Daemon highlighting did not complete within the timeout; results may be partial.")
   224→            }
   225→        }
   226→
   227→        val response = ActionDiscoveryResponse(
   228→            projectName = project.name,
   229→            filePath = virtualFile.path,
   230→            caretOffset = safeOffset,
   231→            documentLength = document.textLength,
   232→            languageId = psiFile.language.id,
   233→            languageDisplayName = psiFile.language.displayName,
   234→            fileType = psiFile.fileType.name,
   235→            actionGroups = actionGroupInfo,
   236→            intentions = IntentionsPayload(
   237→                intentions = intentionsInfo.intentionsToShow.map(::toIntentionActionInfo),
   238→                errorFixes = intentionsInfo.errorFixesToShow.map(::toIntentionActionInfo),
   239→                inspectionFixes = intentionsInfo.inspectionFixesToShow.map(::toIntentionActionInfo),
   240→                notificationActions = intentionsInfo.notificationActionsToShow.map(::toIntentionActionInfo),
   241→                gutterActions = intentionsInfo.guttersToShow.map { toActionInfo(it, null) }
   242→            ),
   243→            gutterIcons = gutterIcons,
   244→            notes = notes
   245→        )
   246→
   247→        val json = McpJson.encodeToString(ActionDiscoveryResponse.serializer(), response)
   248→        return ToolCallResult(content = listOf(ContentItem.Text(text = json)))
   249→    }
   250→
   251→    private fun parseActionGroups(array: JsonArray?): List<String> {
   252→        array ?: return listOf(IdeActions.GROUP_EDITOR_POPUP, IdeActions.GROUP_EDITOR_GUTTER)
   253→        val groups = array
   254→            .mapNotNull { it.jsonPrimitive.contentOrNull }
   255→            .map { it.trim() }
   256→            .filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
   257→            .distinct()
   258→        return groups
   259→    }
   260→
   261→    private fun resolveVirtualFile(project: Project, filePath: String): VirtualFile? {
   262→        val trimmed = filePath.trim()
   263→        if (trimmed.isEmpty()) return null
   264→        val vfs = VirtualFileManager.getInstance()
   265→        val urlCandidates = buildList {
   266→            add(trimmed)
   267→            if (!trimmed.contains("://") && trimmed.contains(":/")) {
   268→                add(trimmed.replaceFirst(":/", "://"))
   269→                add(trimmed.replaceFirst(":/", ":///"))
   270→            }
   271→        }
   272→        for (candidate in urlCandidates) {
   273→            vfs.findFileByUrl(candidate)?.let { return it }
   274→        }
   275→
   276→        val isAbsolute = runCatching { Path.of(trimmed).isAbsolute }.getOrDefault(false)
   277→        val fs = LocalFileSystem.getInstance()
   278→        if (isAbsolute) {
   279→            fs.findFileByPath(trimmed)?.let { return it }
   280→        }
   281→
   282→        val basePath = project.basePath ?: project.guessProjectDir()?.path ?: return null
   283→        val relative = trimmed.trimStart('/')
   284→        val path = "$basePath/$relative"
   285→        return fs.findFileByPath(path)
   286→    }
   287→
   288→    private suspend fun openTextEditor(project: Project, file: VirtualFile, caretOffset: Int): TextEditor? {
   289→        return withContext(Dispatchers.EDT) {
   290→            val editors = FileEditorManager.getInstance(project).openFile(file, true)
   291→            val textEditor = editors.filterIsInstance<TextEditor>().firstOrNull()
   292→            if (textEditor != null && !textEditor.editor.isDisposed) {
   293→                val editor = textEditor.editor
   294→                val safeOffset = caretOffset.coerceIn(0, editor.document.textLength)
   295→                editor.caretModel.moveToOffset(safeOffset)
   296→                editor.scrollingModel.scrollToCaret(ScrollType.CENTER)
   297→            }
   298→            textEditor
   299→        }
   300→    }
   301→
   302→    private suspend fun awaitSmartMode(project: Project) {
   303→        if (!DumbService.isDumb(project)) return
   304→        suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
   305→            fun waitForSmart() {
   306→                DumbService.getInstance(project).smartInvokeLater {
   307→                    if (DumbService.isDumb(project)) {
   308→                        waitForSmart()
   309→                    } else {
   310→                        cont.resume(Unit)
   311→                    }
   312→                }
   313→            }
   314→            waitForSmart()
   315→        }
   316→    }
   317→
   318→    private suspend fun awaitHighlighting(project: Project, editor: TextEditor): Boolean {
   319→        return withTimeoutOrNull(10_000) {
   320→            while (!DaemonCodeAnalyzerEx.isHighlightingCompleted(editor, project)) {
   321→                delay(50)
   322→            }
   323→            true
   324→        } ?: false
   325→    }
   326→
   327→    private suspend fun expandActionGroup(
   328→        group: ActionGroup,
   329→        dataContext: DataContext,
   330→        place: String,
   331→        maxActions: Int,
   332→    ): List<ActionInfo> {
   333→        if (maxActions <= 0) return emptyList()
   334→        val presentationFactory = PresentationFactory()
   335→        val actions = withContext(Dispatchers.EDT) {
   336→            Utils.expandActionGroupSuspend(
   337→                group,
   338→                presentationFactory,
   339→                dataContext,
   340→                place,
   341→                ActionUiKind.POPUP,
   342→                false
   343→            )
   344→        }
   345→        return actions.take(maxActions).map { action ->
   346→            val presentation = presentationFactory.getPresentation(action)
   347→            toActionInfo(action, presentation)
   348→        }
   349→    }
   350→
   351→    private suspend fun collectGutterIcons(
   352→        project: Project,
   353→        document: Document,
   354→        dataContext: DataContext,
   355→        maxActions: Int,
   356→    ): List<GutterIconInfo> {
   357→        val lineMarkers = readAction { DaemonCodeAnalyzerImpl.getLineMarkers(document, project) }
   358→        return lineMarkers.mapNotNull { marker ->
   359→            val renderer = marker.createGutterRenderer() ?: return@mapNotNull null
   360→            val clickAction = renderer.clickAction?.let { toActionInfo(it, null) }
   361→            val popupGroup = renderer.popupMenuActions
   362→            val popupActions = if (popupGroup is ActionGroup && maxActions > 0) {
   363→                expandActionGroup(popupGroup, dataContext, ActionPlaces.EDITOR_GUTTER_POPUP, maxActions)
   364→            } else {
   365→                emptyList()
   366→            }
   367→            GutterIconInfo(
   368→                line = document.getLineNumber(marker.startOffset) + 1,
   369→                startOffset = marker.startOffset,
   370→                endOffset = marker.endOffset,
   371→                tooltip = renderer.tooltipText,
   372→                clickAction = clickAction,
   373→                popupActions = popupActions
   374→            )
   375→        }
   376→    }
   377→
   378→    private fun toIntentionActionInfo(descriptor: HighlightInfo.IntentionActionDescriptor): IntentionActionInfo {
   379→        val action = descriptor.action
   380→        return IntentionActionInfo(
   381→            text = action.text,
   382→            familyName = action.familyName,
   383→            displayName = descriptor.displayName,
   384→            className = action.javaClass.name,
   385→            isError = descriptor.isError,
   386→            isInformation = descriptor.isInformation
   387→        )
   388→    }
   389→
   390→    private fun toActionInfo(action: AnAction, presentation: Presentation?): ActionInfo {
   391→        val template = action.templatePresentation
   392→        return ActionInfo(
   393→            id = ActionManager.getInstance().getId(action),
   394→            text = presentation?.text ?: template.text,
   395→            description = presentation?.description ?: template.description,
   396→            className = action.javaClass.name,
   397→            enabled = presentation?.isEnabled ?: template.isEnabled,
   398→            visible = presentation?.isVisible ?: template.isVisible,
   399→            isSeparator = action is Separator
   400→        )
   401→    }
   402→
   403→    private fun placeForGroup(groupId: String): String = when (groupId) {
   404→        IdeActions.GROUP_EDITOR_GUTTER -> ActionPlaces.EDITOR_GUTTER_POPUP
   405→        IdeActions.GROUP_EDITOR_TAB_POPUP -> ActionPlaces.EDITOR_TAB_POPUP
   406→        else -> ActionPlaces.EDITOR_POPUP
   407→    }
   408→
   409→    private fun errorResult(message: String) = ToolCallResult(
   410→        content = listOf(ContentItem.Text(text = "ERROR: $message")),
   411→        isError = true
   412→    )
   413→}
